meta.title: Invite a vendor via Tax ID

args.goal: Navigate to the Vendors page, click Invite Vendor, enter the vendor POC full name and email, choose Manufacture/Trader, select Tax ID, choose the business-location country, enter the supplied Tax ID, click Next, verify the summary, click Invite, and stop on the Vendors page showing the success message that the invite was sent and the invited vendor row.

steps.note: Performs and observes the complete Tax ID invitation flow, including the summary and both expected post-invite outcomes.
Confirms the final Vendors page has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed content after the invitation.
